# Plan: Prevent duplicate Fragment Title for cloned cards in M@S Studio

## Summary
When a user clones a card in M@S Studio, the clone dialog pre-populates the title with the original fragment's title but does not check for uniqueness. This adds a `generateUniqueTitle` helper to `utils.js` that appends a numeric suffix (`-1`, `-2`, …) when a title collision is detected within the same folder path, and wires it into the `copyFragment` flow in `mas-repository.js`. Both `editor-panel.js` and `mas-fragment-editor.js` are updated so `titleClone` is pre-populated on dialog open, ensuring the dedup runs even when the user accepts the default title unchanged.

## Task Description
- Add a pure `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` helper to `studio/src/utils.js`.
- Pre-populate `this.titleClone` with the current fragment's title in `showClone()` (both `editor-panel.js` and `mas-fragment-editor.js`).
- In `mas-repository.js#copyFragment`, resolve the effective clone title (from user input or fragment title), collect existing titles from `Store.fragments.list.data` scoped to the same folder path, call `generateUniqueTitle`, and pass the deduplicated title when saving the cloned fragment.
- Add unit tests for `generateUniqueTitle` in `studio/test/utils.test.js`.

## Relevant Files

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `studio/src/utils.js` | Add `generateUniqueTitle` helper |
| `studio/src/mas-repository.js` | Call dedup in `copyFragment` (line 1012) |
| `studio/src/editor-panel.js` | Pre-populate `titleClone` in `showClone()` (line 620) |
| `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` | Pre-populate `titleClone` in `showClone()` (line 1088) |
| `studio/test/utils.test.js` | Unit tests for new helper |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `generateUniqueTitle` to `studio/src/utils.js`
- Export a new function `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` where `existingTitles` is a `Set` or array of title strings already in the scope.
- Strip any existing trailing `-N` numeric suffix from `baseTitle` to get the stem (e.g. `lucy-card-1` → `lucy-card`).
- If the base title is not in `existingTitles`, return it unchanged.
- Otherwise, increment from 1 upward (`${stem}-1`, `${stem}-2`, …) until a title not in `existingTitles` is found, then return it.
- Regex for trailing suffix detection: `/^(.*)-(\d+)$/`.

### 2. Pre-populate `titleClone` on dialog open — `editor-panel.js`
- In `showClone()` (line 620), after setting `this.showCloneDialog = true`, add:
  ```js
  this.titleClone = this.fragment?.title ?? '';
  ```
- This ensures `titleClone` is set even if the user accepts the default without typing.

### 3. Pre-populate `titleClone` on dialog open — `mas-fragment-editor.js`
- In `showClone()` (line 1088), after setting `this.showCloneDialog = true`, add:
  ```js
  this.titleClone = this.fragment?.title ?? '';
  ```

### 4. Deduplicate clone title in `mas-repository.js#copyFragment`
- At the top of `copyFragment` (line 1012), before calling `aem.sites.cf.fragments.copy`:
  1. Determine the effective title: `const effectiveTitle = updatedTitle || this.fragmentInEdit.title;`
  2. Derive the folder path from `this.fragmentInEdit.path` by stripping the last segment: `const folderPath = this.fragmentInEdit.path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/');`
  3. Collect titles of all loaded fragments in the same folder from `Store.fragments.list.data`:
     ```js
     const existingTitles = Store.fragments.list.data.get()
         .map(s => s.get?.()?.path?.startsWith(folderPath) ? s.get()?.title : null)
         .filter(Boolean);
     ```
  4. Call `const uniqueTitle = generateUniqueTitle(effectiveTitle, existingTitles);` (import from `./utils.js`).
  5. Pass `uniqueTitle` as `updatedTitle` throughout the rest of the method. Replace the existing `needsSave` check so that `uniqueTitle` (never falsy — at minimum equal to `effectiveTitle`) drives the title update:
     ```js
     const needsSave = uniqueTitle !== result.title || osi;
     if (needsSave) {
         result.title = uniqueTitle;
         // … existing osi field update …
     }
     ```
- Add `import { generateUniqueTitle, showToast } from './utils.js';` if `generateUniqueTitle` is not already imported (merge into existing import).

### 5. Add unit tests in `studio/test/utils.test.js`
- Test `generateUniqueTitle` with:
  - No collision → returns base title unchanged.
  - Collision with base title → returns `baseTitle-1`.
  - Collision with `baseTitle` and `baseTitle-1` → returns `baseTitle-2`.
  - Input already has a `-N` suffix and there is a collision → strips and re-increments correctly.
  - Empty `existingTitles` → always returns base title.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a fragment whose title already exists in the same folder produces a clone titled `{original}-1`.
- Cloning again when `{original}-1` exists produces `{original}-2`.
- Cloning when no title collision exists leaves the title unchanged.
- The original fragment's title is never modified.
- Manual edits to the title field in the clone dialog are respected and still deduplicated.
- `generateUniqueTitle` is a pure function with no side effects, fully covered by unit tests.

- If the base title is not in `existingTitles`, return it unchanged.
- Otherwise, increment from 1 upward (`${stem}-1`, `${stem}-2`, …) until a title not in `existingTitles` is found, then return it.

### 2. Pre-populate `titleClone` on dialog open — `editor-panel.js`
